Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.common

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.common
Beans and enumerations shared by the Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) and Open Data Product Standard (ODPS), including the abstract BitolDocument root that Jackson uses to select the document type from the "kind" property.
  • Related Packages

    Description
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol
    Support for the Bitol open standards for data contracts and data products (https://github.com/bitol-io).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.mapping
    Mappers that catalogue Bitol documents in open metadata (and, in later phases, generate them from open metadata).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odcs
    Beans and enumerations for the Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) v3.x (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-contract-standard/).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odps

  • Class
    Description
    BitolAuthoritativeDefinition
    This class represents a link to a source that provides more details on an element of a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) or Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) document.
    BitolAuthoritativeDefinitionType
    BitolAuthoritativeDefinitionType lists the standard types of link to an authoritative source of information about an element.
    BitolCustomProperty
    This class represents a custom (key/value) property that can be attached to most elements of a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) or Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) document.
    BitolDescription
    This class represents the high-level description of a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract or Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    BitolDocument
    BitolDocument is the abstract root of the documents defined by the Bitol standards: the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) DataContract and the Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) DataProduct.
    BitolModule
    BitolModule is a Jackson module that adds the lenient handling needed to read the range of documents found in the wild: for example ODCS v3.0 documents that supply the team as a bare list of members rather than the team object introduced in v3.1.
    BitolStatus
    BitolStatus lists the standard lifecycle status values of a Bitol data contract (ODCS) or data product (ODPS).
    BitolSupportChannel
    This class represents a support or communication channel for a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract or Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    BitolSupportScope
    BitolSupportScope lists the standard scopes of a support or communication channel.
    BitolSupportTool
    BitolSupportTool lists the standard tools that host a support or communication channel.
    BitolTeam
    This class represents the team responsible for a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract or Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    BitolTeamDeserializer
    BitolTeamDeserializer accepts both forms of the "team" section found in Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) documents.
    BitolTeamMember
    This class represents a member of the team responsible for a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract or Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
